# cgltf

Unmodified cgltf v1.15, pinned to upstream commit 360db1a95480fe102ae9c69b27c5d101167ff5ba. Vesper uses it to parse glTF and GLB containers. Vesper validates supported accessor ranges, decodes geometry and builds the acceleration structure.
